messages.subject: mainPanel map-coordinates reactivity
parts:
Hi (shiny is the thing I was waiting for a long while! Thanks for the great package, elegant / simple and prowerful!)

I have experimented a shiny application where the aim is to extract a time series from a rasterfile using interactiv coordinates. Currently I use sliders to move in X or Y direction, but it would be greate to be able to use (ie) googleMaps. Basically I'm looking for a (eventually nested) googleMaps window (with its drag and zoom capabilites), the extraction of coordinates (by mouse click) and eventually the overlay of raster data in that googleMaps plot.

the server-side uses this coordinates (reactively) to extract the timeserie from a raster file and plots it back to the UI.

Is this possible or is there the idea to do such an implementation.

Thanks!
Matteo
